categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of chairs, focusing on office and home chairs under the Sidiz brand. It also has a premium sofa brand, Alloso, and engages in furniture manufacturing and sales. The company has expanded through acquisition, notably acquiring the chair business from TEEMS in 2018, and operates mainly in the furniture sector without distinct business segment divisions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced ergonomic design and manufacturing technologies for chairs, including plastic injection molding, aluminum die-casting, and use of various materials such as leather, fabric, and sponge. It operates a dedicated chair research institute focused on design, materials, production technology, and ergonomics. Production is carried out mainly at the Pyeongtaek plant with a capacity calculated based on operating hours and output, employing specialized manufacturing infrastructure.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a broad customer base including office environments, households, and educational institutions. Its products are sold domestically through distributors, department stores, large marts, and online channels, and internationally via agents in over 20 countries across Asia, Americas, Europe, and Oceania. The market includes both brand-conscious consumers seeking ergonomic and design-focused chairs and price-sensitive segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Pyeongtaek, South Korea, with sales operations primarily in the domestic market and exports to approximately 20 countries worldwide. Key export regions include Asia (Taiwan, China, Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam), the Americas (USA), Europe (UK, Czech Republic, Poland, Russia), and Oceania (Australia, New Zealand). It does not have overseas subsidiaries but uses agents for international sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of chairs and furniture. It sources raw materials and components such as plastics, metals, leather, and fabrics from specialized suppliers and integrates these into finished products. It controls design, R&D, production, and distribution but relies on external suppliers for key materials and parts.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in ergonomic design, material development, and production technology to maintain market leadership. The company invests in R&D through its dedicated chair research institute, focusing on human-centered design and new product development. It also emphasizes expanding online and overseas markets and enhancing product differentiation through design awards and collaborations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of manufactured chairs and furniture products both domestically and internationally. Sales channels include wholesale to distributors, direct contracts with customers, department stores, large marts, online platforms, and export agents. The company does not currently engage in subscription or licensing models but relies on product sales and some merchandise sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds the number one market share and brand recognition in the domestic chair market. Major competitors include large furniture companies such as Hanssem, Livart, Zinus, and Persis. The company differentiates itself through ergonomic design, product quality, and a broad distribution network, positioning itself as a premium and innovative chair manufacturer.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenues of approximately 200 billion KRW in 2023, down from 243 billion KRW in 2022, with a slight operating loss in 2023. It maintains a solid financial structure with no external borrowings and a current ratio above 200%. The company has experienced fluctuations in sales but continues to invest in R&D and market expansion to sustain growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes ergonomic design, superior quality, and innovative technology in its chairs, supported by a dedicated research institute. It offers a diverse product lineup tailored to different customer life stages and lifestyles, backed by numerous design awards and certifications. Its strong brand recognition, extensive distribution channels, and focus on customer experience differentiate it in a competitive market.
